components.name: CommentInput
components.new_component_justification: No existing component matches the specific requirement for a comment input box at the bottom of the task detail view with validation and submission behavior.
covers_ui_expectations: A comment input box at the bottom of the task detail view

props.onSubmit: Function to submit the comment to the backend

components.name: CommentList
components.new_component_justification: No existing component supports a scrollable list of comments with author name, timestamp, and conditional delete icons based on ownership.
covers_ui_expectations: A scrollable list of existing comments, newest last
A delete icon shown only on the current user's own comments

props.comments: Array of comment objects with author, text, and timestamp
